orcaInp.studio.processPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) matched against "<process name> <command line>" to pick the calculation processes the Studio's Runs tab lists: by default ORCA (orca, orca_*), xtb, crest, Gaussian, CP2K, ABIN, Psi4, mpirun/srun, and Python running PySCF or run_*/ml_worker/from_geometry/from_ensemble/compare_ensembles scripts.

orcaInp.studio.logGlobs.description: Globs of log files the Studio's Runs tab lists (the 50 most recently modified are shown).

orcaInp.studio.logExcludeGlobs.description: Globs left out of the Runs tab's log list, in addition to orcaInp.runs.exclude (default: the per-geometry directories of ensembles).

notes: Runs tab host methods (channel 'runs'): processes, machine, queue, kill {pid, signal: 'TERM'|'KILL'}, logs, tail {path, lines, since}, settings. onNavigate args: { log: <absolute path> } opens the Logs sub-tab with that file's tail, { sub: 'procs' | 'logs' } switches the sub-tab. Process listing spawns ps (Linux/macOS) or powershell.exe -NoProfile (Windows) every 5 s while the tab is visible; squeue is tried once and its absence cached.
